evidence: Running repro.py with torch inputs shaped (3, 1, 1, 4) and RotaryPositionalEmbeddings(3) raises RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (3) must match the size of tensor b (4) at non-singleton dimension 3.
steps: Create the virtual environment and install dependencies with bash setup_env.sh.
Run bash run_repro.sh from the bug folder.
Observe the RoPE forward pass fail with a dimension-3 mismatch in codebase/labml_nn/transformers/rope/__init__.py.
